subject: [PATCH v3 11/12] mm/collapse: declare the collapse interface in collapse.h

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch declares the collapse interface in collapse.h, which includes functions and variables related to collapsing memory pages. The functions are: collapse_control_init, collapse_scan_pmd, collapse_run_pmd, and collapse_control_release. These functions are used for collapsing large pages into smaller ones. The patch also renames hugepage_vma_revalidate to collapse_vma_revalidate and adds comments to explain the order of function calls and lock usage. This is a preparation step for implementing MADV_COLLAPSE in madvise.c, but it does not introduce any functional changes.
